candidate.title: Methyl-Seq/MRE-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Methyl-Seq/MRE-Seq grouped explanatory schematic. Visible inventory: introductory methylated genomic DNA icons; "Split sample" with two retained routes; upper MspI and lower HpaII digestion cartoons labeled CCGG with a symbol above the internal C; a separate "Sequence" route for each digest; common alignment to "determine undigested sites"; and the final "Identified methylation site" icon. The complete drawn paired route is retained at Methyl-Seq schematic scope, with its paper association corroborated at abstract level only. For the distinct target MRE-Seq, the inspected full text resolves the HpaII-sensitive-cleavage purpose but supplies a different pooled-fragment input history and positive unmethylated-site readout; two explicitly primary-supported local interface operations record that distinction. They do not replace the drawing or expand it into a complete MRE-Seq recipe. The catalogue’s MSRE/MRE-Seq shorthand does not make Methyl-Seq and the cited MRE-Seq implementation identical. MeDIP-seq and other assays discussed in the papers, catalogue kits, and background applications are not added as targets.
